verdict.rationale: A public API is a fair question for an IP-office service, so the axis applies. However, the docs describe only web-based filing procedures (trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau) and website database search, with no API reference. The probe shows data.inpi.fr rejecting keyless requests with HTTP 403 and requiring an account-issued token, but it does not establish a documented public API that can drive filings or other operations.
